parts:
Is there some documentation on the arguments to the various extract
functions? Can I extract data for a subset/slice of the files?

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Discussion on export-to-bioconductor
parts:
Hi,

there is no argument for specifying a subset of arrays/files for
extractNnn() methods. Instead you have to extract a data set of the
subset of arrays you want to use and then call extractNnn(), e.g.

idxs <- c(1,5,75:80);
ds2 <- extract(ds, idxs);
Y <- extractMatrix(ds2, units=1:100);

This is an intentional design; the above works in all cases and we
don't have to worry about adding/maintaining an argument 'arrays' in
heaps of places.

/Henrik

Hi pbernin,

I am not sure where did you find this function
"extractExprSet(ChipEffectSet)" ?
The normal procedure is to extract data_frame object out of it and
then extract
data Matrix from the data_frame object. The matrix you can further use
for
ExpressionSet creation.

# Extract the ChipEffectSet from plm Fit
cesEx <- getChipEffectSet(plmEx)

# Data frame creation from ChipEffectSet
exData <- extractDataFrame(cesEx, units=NULL, addNames=TRUE)

# extracting data matrix from relevant column , cause first column
contains group and unit IDs
exExpr <-as.matrix(exData[,6:dim(exData)[2]])

# Create an ExpressionSet
exExpressionSet <- new("ExpressionSet", exprs = exExpr)

Even I am very new aroma.affymetrix. But this is what I have done so
far.

Hope this helps.

Regarding the help() function, other expert might be able to help you
better
as it does not appear for any function in my aroma inatallation
either.
